f3_program: observe(at("intu.auditor.total_fees_paid", "2019"), 1690, "£000", cell("Total fees paid to auditor", "2019"))
observe(at("intu.auditor.total_fees_paid", "2018"), 1104, "£000", cell("Total fees paid to auditor", "2018"))
query("percentage_change", at("intu.auditor.total_fees_paid", "2018"), at("intu.auditor.total_fees_paid", "2019"))
collection("cynthia.potatoes", "potato", "cynthia.garden", source("67 potatoes from her garden"))
observe(at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "initial"), 67, "count", source("Cynthia harvested 67 potatoes from her garden"))
consume("cut_potatoes_for_wedges", "cynthia", at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "current"), 13, source("she cut 13 of them into wedges"))
produce("make_wedges", "cynthia", at("cynthia.wedges.count", "current"), "cynthia.wedges.made.count", source("she cut 13 of them into wedges"))
rate_relation("cynthia.wedges.made.count", 8, event_field("cut_potatoes_for_wedges", "quantity"), source("one potato can be cut into 8 wedges"))
fraction_of("cynthia.french_fries.potatoes_used.count", at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("made french fries with one half"))
fraction_of("cynthia.potato_chips.potatoes_used.count", at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("potato chips with the other half"))
consume("use_potatoes_for_french_fries", "cynthia", at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "current"), "cynthia.french_fries.potatoes_used.count", source("made french fries with one half"))
produce("make_french_fries", "cynthia", at("cynthia.french_fries.quantity", "current"), "cynthia.french_fries.made.quantity", source("made french fries with one half"))
consume("use_potatoes_for_potato_chips", "cynthia", at("cynthia.potatoes.count", "current"), "cynthia.potato_chips.potatoes_used.count", source("potato chips with the other half"))

produce("make_potato_chips", "cynthia", at("cynthia.potato_chips.count", "current"), "cynthia.potato_chips.made.count", source("made french fries with one half, and potato chips with the other half"))
rate_relation("cynthia.potato_chips.made.count", 20, "cynthia.potato_chips.potatoes_used.count", source("one potato can be cut into 8 wedges or make 20 potato chips"))
query("difference", event_field("make_wedges", "quantity"), event_field("make_potato_chips", "quantity"))
assumptions: The two halves refer to the potatoes remaining after 13 potatoes were cut into wedges.

f3_program: observe(at("tim.running.days_per_week", "initial"), 3, "day/week", source("run 3 times a week"))
add("add_running_days", "tim", at("tim.running.days_per_week", "current"), 2, source("add an extra 2 days a week"))
observe(at("tim.running.morning_duration_per_run_day", "now"), 1, "hour", source("1 hour in the morning"))
observe(at("tim.running.evening_duration_per_run_day", "now"), 1, "hour", source("1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening"))

sum_relation(at("tim.running.duration_per_run_day", "now"), at("tim.running.morning_duration_per_run_day", "now"), at("tim.running.evening_duration_per_run_day", "now"), source("1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening every day she runs"))
rate_relation(at("tim.running.duration_per_week", "now"), at("tim.running.duration_per_run_day", "now"), at("tim.running.days_per_week", "current"), source("every day she runs"))
query("value", at("tim.running.duration_per_week", "now"))
assumptions: The phrase "3 times a week" denotes three running days per week, consistent with the later reference to extra days.

f3_program: collection("john.purchased_items", "item", "john", source("John bought a tennis racket. He also bought sneakers that cost $200 and a sports outfit that cost $250"))
member("john.purchased_items", "john.tennis_racket", source("John bought a tennis racket"))
member("john.purchased_items", "john.sneakers", source("He also bought sneakers"))
member("john.purchased_items", "john.sports_outfit", source("a sports outfit"))
observe(at("john.sneakers.price", "purchase"), 200, "$", source("sneakers that cost $200"))
observe(at("john.sports_outfit.price", "purchase"), 250, "$", source("a sports outfit that cost $250"))
observe(at("john.purchased_items.total_price", "purchase"), 750, "$", source("He spent a total of $750 for all those items"))

sum_relation(at("john.purchased_items.total_price", "purchase"), at("john.tennis_racket.price", "purchase"), at("john.sneakers.price", "purchase"), at("john.sports_outfit.price", "purchase"), source("He spent a total of $750 for all those items"))
query("value", at("john.tennis_racket.price", "purchase"))
assumptions: The phrase "all those items" refers to the tennis racket, sneakers, and sports outfit.

f3_program: observe(at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 17, "count", source("Napoleon has 17 jelly beans"))
offset(at("sedrich.jelly_beans.count", "current"), at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("Sedrich has 4 more jelly beans than Napoleon"))
sum_relation("napoleon_and_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), at("sedrich.jelly_beans.count", "current"), source("the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans"))
multiple("twice_napoleon_and_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", "napoleon_and_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", 2, source("twice the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans"))
multiple("four_times_mikey.jelly_beans.count", at("mikey.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 4, source("4 times the number of jelly beans that Mikey has"))

same("twice_napoleon_and_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", "four_times_mikey.jelly_beans.count", source("twice the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans is 4 times the number of jelly beans that Mikey has"))
query("value", at("mikey.jelly_beans.count", "current"))
